01 / 2026

Price Action Trainer

EDUCATION · CHART PRACTICE

LEARNING THROUGH DOING

Read.
Decide.
Repeat.

+Historical charts.
Hands-on practice.
ACTUAL APP SCREENSCLICK TO EXPLORE +

A learning app for practising decisions on historical charts without seeing the future candles. I developed the product independently, from the Flutter interface and chart experience to AI-assisted review and subscriptions.

My role / team
Independent product developer · Solo
Under the hood
Flutter · Custom chart rendering
Drift / SQLite · RevenueCat
View on App Store ↗Listed as Price Action Trading Simulator

MY CONTRIBUTION

From the chart to the learning loop.

01
Chart & practice experience

Built the Flutter screens and custom candlestick rendering for hidden-chart practice. Implemented the candle-by-candle flow and Long / Short decision controls.

02
Lessons & AI-assisted review

Connected structured learning with chart practice and an AI review interface covering market structure, confirmation and risk–reward feedback.

03
Product infrastructure & release

Worked with Drift / SQLite for local data and RevenueCat for subscriptions, and took the app through App Store publication.

DELIVERED

A published learning product combining chart interaction, practice and review. First App Store release: July 2026.

02 / 2025

AI Lingo / Speaky AI

LANGUAGE LEARNING · AI
Say hello.
A LITTLE PRACTICE. EVERY DAY.ACTUAL APP SCREENS +

An English-learning product built around speaking with an AI tutor, daily lessons and personalised feedback. As the independent developer, I connected the mobile interface, voice interaction, backend APIs and subscription flow.

My role / team
Independent product developer · Solo
Under the hood
Flutter · Riverpod · Audio streaming
Firebase · ASP.NET · RevenueCat
Meet Speaky AI ↗AI Lingo’s current App Store name

MY CONTRIBUTION

Making a speaking lesson work end to end.

01
Learning interface & state

Built the Flutter learning screens: the A1–C2 roadmap, daily lesson path, conversation view and feedback. Used Riverpod to manage application state.

02
Voice & AI integration

Integrated audio streaming and AI conversation into the speaking flow, with feedback on pronunciation, grammar and word choice shown in the lesson interface.

03
APIs, subscriptions & release

Connected the app with ASP.NET APIs and Firebase, integrated RevenueCat subscriptions, and handled the App Store release under the Speaky AI name.

DELIVERED

A published English-learning app with voice conversations, learning paths and subscriptions. First App Store release: December 2025.
